title: OHC Party
description: Anyone other than the subject who asserts, narrates, receives, holds or appears in the context: people, agents, software and organizations. Parts are never Parties (P-1).

id.description: Prefix p- (person), a- (agent), s- (software or system) or o- (organization).

label.description: Pseudonymous wherever possible. Examples use role labels only.

odeRef.description: The ODE Party, Agent or DigitalEmployee this party explicitly corresponds to. Not authentication or access; a role or working-configuration change does not transfer a grant (ODE binding section 9).
